contract: Use CommonMark block structure to preserve original fenced and indented code bytes inside blockquotes and lists. Only existing v2 container list-marker normalization may change the opening line outside literal content. Never round-trip through a Markdown serializer.

cases.LC01: Top-level, quoted, list-contained and mixed/nested tilde/backtick fences preserve code URLs and list-like literal lines.
cases.LC02: Ordinary sibling prose links still convert before/after nested blocks and after a container ends; list-marker normalization outside literals stays unchanged.
cases.LC03: Fence delimiter lengths, trailing closing text, unclosed blocks, quote depth, ordered-list indentation, tabs and CRLF retain their actual block boundaries.
cases.LC04: Container-indented code stays literal while list continuation paragraphs are recognized as prose. Ambiguous parser nesting overflow refuses before approval.
cases.LC05: Actual Writer approval and local HTTP receive the exact nested-literal representation; changed provider bytes still leave uncertainty and historical replay remains unchanged.

limits: Original failed review and interrupted LP03 remain retained. No new provider/model/credential/tunnel effects or live acceptance.
